The Role

Are you looking for a place where your work makes an impact? We are seeking a talented Cloud CRM Consultant to join our amazing, fast-paced team of experts in Hungary.

The Cloud CRM Consultant is a member of our Commercial Managed Services team who provides ongoing professional service for customers live with Veeva’s commercial solutions.

You will  provide application consulting services to the Veeva Commercial Cloud product suite, primarily on the Vault CRM application, but will potentially develop expertise across other Commercial products. You will identify customer requirements, perform configuration changes to the system, activate new product features and act as an advising partner.

This is a remote, full-time role with Veeva. Candidates must be legally authorised to be employed in Europe. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position. There may be travel opportunities at select times of the year for internal events.

• Provide post-go-live consulting and administrative services

• Activate new product features and ensure seamless integration

• Troubleshoot system issues and provide timely solutions

• Strong desire to continuously learn and develop

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• Ability to work independently

Nice to Have

• Technical CRM experience, ideally Salesforce MS, Dynamics, SAP or equivalent

• Customer facing IT Consultancy

• Experience working in the Life-Sciences industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision. 

Perks & Benefits

• Private medical insurance

• Life assurance

At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML, Toolset, and PTC, we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance.

AI is a core part of how we work. AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results.

We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it.

What You’ll Work On

• 

Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why.

• 

Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable.

• 

AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards.

• 

Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it.

• 

Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works.

• 

Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them.

What We’re Looking For

• 

You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality.

• 

You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement.

• 

You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content.

• 

You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't.

• 

You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results.

• 

You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business.

• 

You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions.

• 

You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content.

We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential.

We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional.

Why Join Us

OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide.

You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI.

You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results.

We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life.

If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

About the Role: 

We are looking for a mission-driven health coach to join our team to provide world-class care delivery services to Maven members. Our Care Delivery team consists of care coaches and care advocates who help our members navigate digital care and access the tools to unlock their best experience and outcomes. Our team works to continuously learn more about members and ourselves, and you’ll move fast to adapt and grow as we implement data-driven strategies for improving the lives of our members through a shared coaching model. As a Care Coach, you’ll coordinate care for our members beyond the digital space. Through goal setting and program opt-in, you’ll drive behavior change and improved outcomes for higher risk members. 

Our Care Delivery team works remotely and supports Maven members 24/7/365. We are currently hiring for the following shift:

• Monday-Friday 3-11:30p EST

What You’ll Do:

• Drive program engagement by clearly communicating the value of Maven’s care coaching model, optimizing opt-in rates, and supporting long-term behavior change

• Lead with data by remotely monitoring member health data and platform activity to identify risks early and follow established protocols and procedures to take appropriate action

• Remove barriers to care by coordinating seamlessly across Maven’s digital network, in-person provider networks, and external partners as needed

• Embrace a continuous-learning mindset by participating in and leading efforts to improve quality of care and clinical outcomes

• Ability to communicate with patients empathetically in writing and verbally, and passionate about creating a positive member experience with optimal outcomes  

• Experience achieving KPIs relevant to patient outcomes, including but not limited to opt-in rates, follow-up adherence and member satisfaction 

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adapt to new digital health tools and platforms, with comfort operating in a fast-changing tech environment

• Embrace AI tools as part of daily workflows to enhance efficiency and improve member outcomes

• Strong telehealth competency, including comfort in conducting phone outreach and video calls. Reliable access to high-speed internet

• Health coaching certification (NBC-HWC or ICF) is preferred, not required 

• Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment with ability to navigate systems quickly and adapt to change is preferred, not required 

• Experience coaching across multiple modalities such as video, text/chat, and phone; adapting communication style to fit member need is preferred, not required 

• Comfort with technology tools like Google suite, CRM platforms, EHRs, and Zendesk is preferred, not required 

The base salary range for this role is $62,000 - $78,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

Job Description

We're Hiring: AI/ML Engineer

Vowels of the People Association (VOPA)

Location: Kothrud, Pune (In-Office)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 0–3 Years (Freshers Welcome)

Salary: Based on demonstrated skills

Apply at: https://careers.vopa.in

About VOPA

Vowels of the People Association (VOPA) is a Pune-based organization working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and education technology for social impact.

Our flagship product, NIPUN Maharashtra, powers foundational literacy and numeracy assessments across 70,000+ schools in Maharashtra, serving 5 million students.

We build AI that works for underserved populations — real classrooms, real children, real impact.

About The Role

We are looking for a passionate and technically strong AI/ML Engineer to join our team.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a research orientation. You will work on fine-tuning open-source models, designing machine learning pipelines, and deploying production-ready AI systems at scale.

Our Key Focus Areas Include

• Handwritten answer evaluation
• Marathi Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
• Computer Vision for Indic scripts
• Low-resource language AI models
• Efficient cloud and on-device AI inference

What makes this role exciting?

We have already shipped a fine-tuned vision model (Gemma 4 31B using Unsloth and LoRA) that surpasses many state-of-the-art models on Marathi children's handwriting recognition.

You will build on this foundation, improve existing systems, and explore new approaches to solving challenging AI problems.

Important: This is not a data annotation or prompt engineering role. We are looking for someone who understands how machine learning models work internally.

Key Responsibilities

• Model Fine-Tuning & Training
• Fine-tune open-source LLMs and vision models using LoRA, QLoRA, and other Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques.
• Work with Hugging Face Transformers, Unsloth, and PEFT libraries.
• Optimize GPU training performance and resource utilization.
• Experiment with model architectures for domain-specific educational applications.
• Computer Vision & Speech AI
• Develop models for Marathi handwriting recognition and answer evaluation.
• Work on speech recognition systems for Marathi and other Indic languages.
• Design AI-based rubric scoring and evaluation mechanisms.
• Handle noisy, inconsistent, and low-resource real-world datasets.
• Model Deployment & Optimization
• Deploy fine-tuned models to AWS infrastructure, including ECS/Fargate and GPU inference endpoints.
• Optimize inference performance, latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost.
• Explore quantization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and other inference optimization techniques.
• Investigate on-device AI deployment for Android applications.
• ML Pipelines & Evaluation
• Build end-to-end ML pipelines covering data preprocessing, augmentation, training, evaluation, and serving.
• Define and track evaluation metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and Devanagari-aware benchmarks.
• Perform structured error analysis to identify model weaknesses.
• Improve model reliability and accuracy through systematic experimentation.
• Research & Engineering Collaboration
• Read and evaluate recent AI/ML research papers.
• Translate research ideas into practical experiments and production implementations.
• Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate AI models into FastAPI services.
• Contribute to technical decisions regarding model architecture, training, and deployment.

Required Technical Skills

Model Fine-Tuning & Deep Learning

• Strong understanding of Transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, embeddings, and positional encoding.
• Knowledge of encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder architectures.
• Hands-on experience with LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning using Hugging Face PEFT or Unsloth.
• Understanding of model quantization techniques such as NF4, GPTQ, and AWQ.
• Familiarity with learning rate scheduling, gradient accumulation, and mixed-precision training.
• Ability to diagnose training instability, loss spikes, and gradient-related issues.

ML Engineering & Programming

• Good programming skills in Python or Rust.
• Proficiency in PyTorch, including autograd, tensor operations, and custom loss functions.
• Experience with Computer Vision (CNNs, image preprocessing, augmentation) and/or Speech AI (CTC, attention-based models, audio feature extraction).
• Understanding of dataset preparation, labeling strategies, and train/validation/test splits.
• Ability to write clean, modular, production-oriented code.

Model Deployment & Inference

• Experience deploying ML models using Docker and cloud infrastructure.
• Familiarity with GPU-based inference environments.
• Understanding of inference optimization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and KV caching.
• Awareness of model size, latency, and runtime constraints for edge devices.
• Ability to balance inference cost, latency, and throughput.

Preferred Skills (Not Mandatory)

• Experience using Unsloth for efficient model fine-tuning.
• Familiarity with Marathi, Devanagari, or multilingual NLP/ASR systems.
• Experience working with children's handwriting or speech datasets.
• Knowledge of AWS services such as ECS, S3, CloudFront, and Lambda.
• Exposure to model watermarking, AI model security, or on-device inference protection.

Who Can Apply?

We Welcome Applications From

• Freshers with strong practical AI/ML skills and demonstrable projects.
• Engineers with 0–3 years of relevant experience.
• Candidates who have independently fine-tuned or deployed ML models.
• Individuals who enjoy research, experimentation, and solving real-world engineering challenges.

A Specific Degree Or Certification Is Not Required.

We value demonstrated technical skills, problem-solving ability, and hands-on experience over academic credentials.

Our Selection Process

Our hiring process is entirely skill-based.

Candidates will be evaluated through a practical technical assessment designed to test their understanding of AI/ML concepts and their ability to solve real engineering problems.

Degrees and certifications will not determine selection.

What We Offer

• Real-world impact: Build AI systems used across 70,000+ schools, reaching millions of children.
• Meaningful engineering challenges: Work on low-resource languages, handwritten text recognition, speech AI, and edge deployment.
• Technical ownership: Take responsibility for research, development, optimization, and deployment.
• Collaborative environment: Work with a technically strong, mission-driven team.
• Growth opportunities: Contribute to AI research and architectural decisions as VOPA scales.
• High autonomy: We value outcomes, independent thinking, and engineering excellence.

Apply Now

Interested in building AI systems that create meaningful educational impact?

Submit Your Application Through Our Official Careers Portal

https://careers.vopa.in

Applications are accepted only through the VOPA Careers Portal.

Vowels of the People Association (VOPA)

Building technology for meaningful social impact.

Salary Range

4.00 - 5.00 LPA
